correctness.rationale: Model and hypotheses copied from primary equation (6), with the strict required coexistence α<a*<β. Binary relative entropy gives a proper positive definite function on the open rectangle. Its time derivative is exactly δ a/ε (x-x*)[S_N(x)-S_N(x*)], negative off x=x* since S_N strictly decreases. On x=x*, the vector field points transversely except at a=a*, so LaSalle and compact sublevels imply every interior solution converges. Tests on the actual standalone verify.py include 2400 exact rational cases and 20 logistic-coordinate trajectories, not used as a substitute for proof. Boundary and non-coexistence cases are excluded.

value.rationale: The 2023 adaptive institutional-reward model motivates a global cooperation stabilization guarantee, but its local Jacobian and sampled phase portraits do not establish one. A proper, explicit relative-entropy certificate rigorously covers all interior initial states and all positive relative speeds and excludes recurrent interior oscillations, replacing a small-speed modeling assumption with an all-speed mathematical theorem. This is a meaningful dynamical-system guarantee for the model, not a routine finite enumeration or arbitrary parameter substitution.
